message:
I’ve been spending a lot of time thinking about storms lately. When the skies darken and the wind starts to howl, it’s a good reminder to get our ducks in a row, or at least our flashlights and snacks. I’ve found that preparing for a storm can lead to rediscovering some low-tech fun—like board games, storytelling, or even just reminiscing about the good ol’ days. 

It’s a chance to unplug and enjoy each other’s company, even if the weather outside is less than delightful. So, let’s embrace the cozy chaos together! What’s your favorite way to pass the time when the storm clouds roll in? ☔
